# SECOND SPEAKER

<!-- Generated by npm run records -- build. Edit production.json and canonical documents. -->

Status: **published**.

Published on YouTube; the director supplied the URL on 2026-11-23 (user-confirmed). An old woman teaches a small device the language only she speaks, and the subtitles arrive as it learns; then her granddaughter, who has been practising with it, says hello. Built 2026-11-22 from thirteen takes, all first attempts and all in the cut. Every voice is an ElevenLabs dub (speech-to-speech from each take's guide performance, the device from text) in a language invented for the film and checked against real ones. The director watched draft v1, approved it without notes and authorized the 4K finish; v1-4k is the published master. The description recorded here is the director's edit of the text delivered with the master. Technical checks, approval, finishing authorization and publication are separate events; real-time listening is the director's and is not claimed by the agent. Archived 2026-11-23 under the standard retention: the 4K master, voice stems, references, prompts, timelines, the assembler, delivery records and QA are kept locally; the generated takes are in the private backup; the native draft, the unused alternate-voice cut and derived mixes were removed.
